name: metr_point_v0_wsp_balanced_v2
rationale: Freeze the less aggressive weight-space candidate for the full benchmark. Halve the two adaptive GCN channel groups driven by random factors absent from the original checkpoint. Sharpen only final-MLP neuron 202 by multiplying its incoming affine row by 4 and dividing its effective outgoing coefficient by 4; this suppresses its negative GELU tail while preserving the positive linear asymptote. The additional widening of neuron 9 is excluded because its calibration gain did not yield a better MSE tradeoff in confirmation. No training, derivatives or optimizer updates are used. All selection precedes test evaluation.
